title: MT61141: Solidification Processing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Plane front solidification of single phase alloys, interface stability,
Czochralski growth, growth of single crystals of high perfection, cellular
solidification, cellular-dendritic transition, plane front solidification of
polyphase alloys, macro- and micro-morphology of eutectic growth, growth of
graphite in cast irons, some problems in solidification of polyphase alloys,
inclusions - their formation and distribution; Rheocasting, thixocasting,
electroslag casting, casting of composites.
